tools.name: shop_vehicles
tools.description: Search and rank participating US/Canadian dealer cars, SUVs, trucks, EVs, motorcycles, RVs and trailers by place (including near me), budget, mileage, make/model, condition, body, fuel and features. Quebec excluded. Accepts the shopper’s wording and optional structured filters. Named-dealer stock us

tools.name: get_vehicle
tools.description: For full detail, pass exact shop_vehicles listing_id; returns dealer.dealer_id.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search participating inventory for compact citation IDs, titles and source URLs.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Return citation text and metadata for one exact listing ID returned by search.

tools.name: compare_vehicles
tools.description: Compare two to four distinct returned listing IDs using current inventory facts. Missing data is not an assessment of the vehicle.

tools.name: find_dealerships
tools.description: Find participating dealerships by name or place with IDs, addresses and listing counts. Returned dealer_id values select named-dealer stock; get_dealership provides contacts and sales/service hours.

tools.name: get_dealership
tools.description: Use this with an exact dealer_id to return every public rooftop, contact, site, capability, and named sales/service schedule.

tools.name: schedule_test_drive
tools.description: After explicit consent and confirmation, request a test drive for this listing.

tools.name: request_trade_in_appraisal
tools.description: After explicit consent and confirmation, request a trade-in appraisal for this listing.

tools.name: submit_vehicle_inquiry
tools.description: After explicit consent and confirmation, send this listing's dealer a question.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search · Private data: find_dealerships, get_dealership · Public sink: submit_vehicle_inquiry.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search · Private data: find_dealerships, get_dealership · Public sink: submit_vehicle_inquiry

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
